title: Houthis claim seven missile and drone operations on Aramco sites and Saudi airports
detail: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed strikes on Aramco facilities at Yanbu, Rabigh refinery, pumping stations, the East-West pipeline, and airports at Riyadh, Dammam and Najran plus an air base near Khamis Mushait, saying Dammam air traffic halted. Claims are unconfirmed by Saudi authorities in the source; single report.
